name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
description: Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: render your local Wallpaper Engine Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, with iOS-style liquid glass, adjustable scrim/border/blur, and a customizable accent color + glass transparency for the whole settings window. Prerequisites (update BOTH first): latest DeepSeek Harness (0.1.5-rc.1+ / DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7) and dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19.0.
